preconditions.description: Input s must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i] == return_value[len(return_value) - 1 - i] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: The output string is a palindrome that contains the original string s as a suffix.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == min(len(p) for p in [p for p in [s + s[::-1][:i] for i in range(len(s) + 1)] if all(p[j] == p[len(p) - 1 - j] for j in range(len(p)))] if s in p])
postconditions.description: The output string is the shortest possible palindrome that can be formed by adding characters in front of s.
